name: Human Protein Atlas
goodFor: Images and data on where proteins are found in human cells and tissues.

ProteinTalks-DB Non-commercial research use, additional restrictions apply

notes: Checked against the Licence & Citation page. The Atlas's own copyrightable content is CC BY 4.0 and the page welcomes commercial use, but it says third-party data is mixed in and the user must make sure their use doesn't infringe those rights; its table of external sources lists terms that differ (user terms, CC BY-SA 3.0 and 4.0, a NonCommercial row for ProteinTalks-DB, and a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 row for AlphaFold 3). The Atlas's own images and the third-party data can't be told apart cleanly from the pages read, so only a link is recorded. It also sets citation rules that apply when content is displayed: cite a primary publication and the website, and credit images as "Human Protein Atlas" with the versioned URL. A research resource rather than a course text, so useful for examples in introductory biology. Older versions were licensed differently (not checked). The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
